name: Line-Item Banker's Rounding vs. Half-Up
description: Tax is rounded HALF_EVEN per line item before summing, causing $0.01–$0.03 invoice drifts if rounded at invoice total level.
symptom: Canonical tax_amount diverges by 0.01-0.03 on multi-item orders with fractional cent tax amounts.

name: HTTP 200 OK with Error Envelope
description: Over-limit orders return HTTP 200 with {'ok': true, 'errCode': 'E_CREDIT_CAP'} instead of standard 400/422 status.
symptom: Candidate returns HTTP 422 or 400 when customer exceeds credit limit, breaking legacy envelope parsers.

name: Hidden PL/pgSQL BEFORE INSERT Trigger
description: A silent database trigger applies a 5% loyalty rebate on orders over $1,000 for Tier-A accounts.
symptom: Database row in candidate_db has discount_amount = 0.00 while legacy_db has 5% loyalty discount row and adjusted net_total.

name: Naive Timestamp IST/UTC Cutoff Bug
description: Daily reconciliation buckets transactions using server-local time (IST UTC+5:30) instead of UTC midnight.
symptom: Transactions between 18:30 UTC and 23:59 UTC are counted in the next calendar day in legacy_db.

name: Null vs. Empty-String Serialization
description: Legacy JDBC maps missing promo_code to '' on quotes but null on order receipts.
symptom: Quote response has promo_code: '' when absent, but submit response has promo_code: null.

name: Implicit Idempotency Window (60s)
description: Duplicate POST /orders/submit with matching (customer_id, cart_hash) within 60s returns cached order ID instead of creating a second row.
symptom: Resubmitting identical payload within 60s creates duplicate order and charge in naive candidate.

name: Partial-Refund Proportional Tax Cap
description: Refunding the final item absorbs residual rounding pennies so total refunded tax + subtotal never exceeds original charge.
symptom: Last item refund differs by $0.01 or total refunded sum exceeds initial order charge.

name: Case-Insensitive Header Routing
description: Legacy custom header X-Tenant-Tier: enterprise (or any case) silently overrides DB tenant pricing to 15% discount.
symptom: Candidate relies only on customer table tier and ignores client X-Tenant-Tier header override.

name: Soft-Deleted Customer Ghost Balance
description: Archived accounts (is_active = false) still accrue late fees during /ledger/reconcile unless explicitly zeroed.
symptom: Candidate filters WHERE is_active = true, ignoring dormant debt accounts and causing ledger drift.

name: Artificial N+1 Query Latency Spike
description: Legacy runs an unindexed per-item JDBC lookup (250–600ms P99), giving the Cloud Run candidate a measurable speedup benchmark.
symptom: Legacy P99 latency spikes above 250ms on multi-item orders.
